report_md:
## Vacancy assessment

**Verdict:** unknown (0.20 confidence).

Public property profiles identify the subject APN as a two-unit residential building. Zillow says it is not currently listed for sale or rent on Zillow, and Redfin labels it off market. Neither status establishes that the units are vacant. The county waste assessment roll also lists the parcel with two units; this is a parcel and unit-count signal, not occupancy evidence.

No parcel-specific record establishing physical vacancy, a move-out date, or continuous vacancy was found. No utility data or dated street-level observation was available in this research pass. Oakland's public Kiosk offers permit and private-property enforcement searches, but a parcel-specific result was not retrieved.

**Start/duration:** Unknown. The public records reviewed do not establish when either unit became vacant or any period of continuous vacancy.

**Sources:** [Redfin property profile](https://www.redfin.com/CA/Oakland/1228-Magnolia-St-94607/home/1714859); [Zillow property profile](https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/1228-Magnolia-St-Oakland-CA-94607/24738801_zpid/); [Alameda County Waste Management Authority FY 2025-26 preliminary levy roll](https://www.stopwaste.org/sites/default/files/ACWMA%20-%20Preliminary%20Levy%20Roll%20FY%202025-26.pdf); [Oakland Kiosk](https://apps.oaklandca.gov/Kiosk/).
